+            exports.append(item)
+    idx = store / 'session_index.jsonl'
+    index_rows = []
+    if idx.exists():
+        for line in idx.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines():
+            r = json.loads(line)
+            if r.get('id') in found:
+                index_rows.append(r)
+    (DRAFT / 'traces/session-index.filtered.jsonl').write_text(
+        ''.join(json.dumps(x, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n' for x in index_rows), encoding='utf-8')
+    indexed = {x['id'] for x in index_rows}
+    for item in exports:
+        item['sidebar_index_present'] = item['id'] in indexed
+        item['comate_sessionUuid'] = 'not applicable: Codex native runtime, no Comate store'
+        item['ide_sidebar_id'] = item['id'] if item['id'] in indexed else None
+    trace_manifest = {'exported_at': now(), 'method': 'byte-copy task-only native rollout JSONL; lossless mechanical Markdown reading copies',
+                      'redaction': 'none in native copies; original hashes retained; no mixed overview copied',
+                      'comate_store_exists': (Path.home() / '.comate-engine/store/comate_chat_sessions.jsonl').exists(),
+                      'search': {'by_project_path': sorted(set(path_matches)), 'by_task_id': sorted(set(task_matches)),
+                                 'outside_scope_candidates_not_exported': outside, 'excluded_mixed_session': MIXED},
+                      'files': exports, 'registered_missing': sorted(set(registered) - set(found)),
+                      'sidebar_index_source': str(idx), 'snapshot_only': True}
+    write_json(DRAFT / 'traces/manifest.json', trace_manifest)
+    for p in sorted((ROOT / 'logs').rglob('*')):
+        if p.is_file() and '__pycache__' not in p.parts and p.suffix not in ('.pyc', '.pyo'):
+            target = DRAFT / 'logs' / p.relative_to(ROOT / 'logs')
+            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+            shutil.copy2(p, target)
+    log_files = sorted(p for p in (DRAFT / 'logs').rglob('*') if p.is_file())
+    write_json(DRAFT / 'logs-manifest.json', {'created_at': now(), 'files': [
+        {'path': p.relative_to(DRAFT).as_posix(), 'bytes': p.stat().st_size, 'sha256': sha(p.read_bytes())}
+        for p in log_files], 'excluded': ['__pycache__/', '*.pyc', '*.pyo']})
+    # Common is not an independent repository if git resolves to its parent.
+    common_top = run(['git', '-C', str(COMMON), 'rev-parse', '--show-toplevel']).decode().strip()
+    taskbooks = {}
+    for name in ('0-analyze.md', '1-do.md', '2-submit.md', '3-package.md'):
+        taskbooks[name] = {'common_sha256': sha((COMMON / 'spec-harness' / name).read_bytes()),
+                           'task_copy_sha256': sha((ROOT / 'spec-harness' / name).read_bytes())}
+    history = [str(p.relative_to(ROOT)).replace('\\', '/') for p in (ROOT / 'spec/history').rglob('*') if p.is_file()] if (ROOT / 'spec/history').exists() else []
+    write_json(DRAFT / 'provenance.json', {'created_at': now(), 'base_commit': state['base_commit'],
+        'head': run(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD']).decode().strip(),
+        'common_git_toplevel': common_top, 'common_is_independent_git_repo': Path(common_top).resolve() == COMMON.resolve(),
+        'taskbook_versions': taskbooks, 'history': history,
+        'official_baseline_log_exists': Path('D:/SWE-OpenHarmony/reports/build-baselines/vg-spec14.log').exists(),
+        'local_baseline_record': 'project/logs/prepare-baseline.log',
+        'native_runtime': 'Codex Desktop', 'cli_version_current_environment': os.environ.get('CODEX_VERSION'),
+        'production_fingerprint': json.loads((ROOT / 'workflow/do-final-integrity.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8')),
+        'source_snapshot': 'project/workflow/do-source-final.json'})
+    fragment = {'task_id': 'vg-spec14', 'status': 'submitted', 'project_path': 'tasks/vg-spec14/project',
+                'build_instructions': 'tasks/vg-spec14/build.md', 'trace_index': 'tasks/vg-spec14/trace-index.md'}
+    write_json(DRAFT / 'submission.json.fragment', fragment)
+    print(json.dumps({'exported_sessions': len(exports), 'missing': trace_manifest['registered_missing'],

    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def write_json(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')


def run(args, cwd=ROOT, env=None):
    p = subprocess.run(args, cwd=cwd, env=env, capture_output=True)
    if p.returncode:
        raise RuntimeError(f'{args!r}: exit {p.returncode}: {p.stderr.decode("utf-8", "replace")[-5000:]}')
    return p.stdout

    return (path.startswith('.comate/submission-draft/') or MIXED in path
